## Objective

Advance repository step 12 with one behavior-neutral owner batch: expose stable owner-owned production contribution entry points and exact inventory factories for Identity Resolution, Customer Data Operations and Data Quality, merge them through crm-first-party-modules, relocate Data Quality owner-specific composition out of the generic process host, and remove the three owners' ordinary registration or inventory bypasses from generic runtime while preserving exact inventory, ordering, activation, authorization and execution behavior.

## Deliverables

- `Identity Resolution exposes exact mutation/query definition factories and one activation-gated production contribution builder preserving candidate and merge-lineage semantic validation`
- `Customer Data Operations exposes exact mutation/query definition factories and one activation-gated production contribution builder preserving immutable source artifacts and capability authorization`
- `Data Quality owner-specific planner and executor composition move from crm-application-runtime into the existing owner composition crate without behavior changes`
- `Data Quality exposes exact mutation/query definition factories and one activation-gated production contribution builder preserving governed Party reads and remediation authorization`
- `crm-first-party-modules merges the three owners after the accepted relationship-owner sequence and preserves exact application inventory order`
- `generic application runtime no longer constructs or registers the three owners directly`
- `native composition guards reject renewed direct definition or registration bypasses`
- `Cargo.lock records only intentional internal path-edge changes and no package or external dependency version change`
